additional_analytical_decisions: Reconstruct collateral capacity from concentration definitions with distinct counterfactual denominators, then connect an inventory purchase to both its cash funding and its changing collateral value. Reverse-solve the largest self-funded purchase across binding regimes.
reference_method: Executable economic model with a separate derivation, valid alternative SQL and financial invariant checks

controls.name: row_order
controls.rationale: Ordering of input rows has no financial meaning.

controls.name: scale
controls.rationale: Scale every monetary input, including dollar caps, while retaining rates.

controls.name: letters_of_credit
controls.rationale: Letters of credit consume aggregate facility capacity.

controls.name: reserves
controls.rationale: Additional reserves affect concentration denominators as well as total collateral.

controls.name: purchase_mix
controls.rationale: Changing inventory composition changes collateral created by the same cash purchase.

controls.name: commitment
controls.rationale: Lower lender commitment can bind independently of collateral capacity.

controls.name: dollar_cap
controls.rationale: A higher scripts dollar cap exposes the distinct percentage limit.

controls.name: sublimits
controls.rationale: Unused subfacility size alone does not create aggregate borrowing capacity.

controls.name: seasonal_rate
controls.rationale: The applicable inventory rate affects both collateral categories and the funding frontier.

source_review: Primary source headings, definitions and factual values inspected. Independent human review remains pending.
model_exposure: No candidate trials before initial freeze. Source groups are separate from development tasks. Published references remain a contamination risk.
execution: Baseline task resources and frozen financial scorer reused. Experimental SQL worker 1.0.1 permits zero-column reads for ordinary COUNT/EXISTS and CTE inputs and keeps temporary query storage within the unchanged memory allowance. Schema/module and filesystem restrictions remain. Qualified GLM uses 3600 seconds and 24 turns. Native Sol uses 3600 seconds and has no equivalent turn cap.
